newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish SOP sets August pulp benchmark at $556.24.
newsitem.headline: Finnish SOP sets August pulp benchmark at $556.24.

text.p: Suomen Optioporssi, a Finnish options exchange, on Tuesday published some historic benchmark pulp prices for its planned options listings SOPI.
The benchmark Pulp Indicator Index (PIX) values for northern bleached softwood kraft were $556.24 in August, $554.59 in July and $517.73 in June, the exchange said.
It compiles the index using data from buyers, sellers and consultants, and plans to update it weekly once the pulp options are launched, which is due to happen on September 23.
